sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER
None appears for the petitioners even when the matter is called out for the second time today.
The writ petition is of the year 2016.
It appears that the petitioners are not interested in prosecuting the writ petition.
The writ petition is accordingly dismissed for non-prosecution.
